'''Joe Alread Third Anthology Updated Echo Base Operations''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Joe Alread]]
* '''Published:''' June 2000 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)|Hoth-L-hothmainpowergenerators.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Third Anthology Updated Echo Base Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 Third Anthology Updated Echo Base O.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

Light Side - Echo Base updated with Third Anthology card, A New Secret Base

The deck here is something you might encounter at a tournament now that Third Anthology is out. Be ready for it!

== Strategy ==

how it works:

Past versions of Echo Base Operations were card intensive, and extremely slow. Now with the new Third Anthology card A New Secret Base, you can have EBO set up as early as turn two!

Start fishing for sites and the actual EBO effect right off the bat, and draw if you need some guys in order to occupy the necessary three Echo sites. Once you've occupied the base, deploy EBO, deploy as many systems as you possibly can, and drain away.

Use Rebel Barrier, Hyper Escape, Houjix and Alternatives to Fighting to keep your opponent away from you, and the Force drains should be too much and too early for your opponent to handle. Use Ice Storm to keep the Dark Side off Hoth, and use the Undercover spies to take care of any Tatooine drain decks you might encounter

Joe Alread, ''Contributor'', ''decipher.com ''
